independent_evaluation.training_coordinates_excluded: The frozen training collocation phase is 0.5 on each case-specific grid; this validation phase is distinct.
independent_evaluation.derivatives: PyTorch autograd for the network and analytic derivatives for the MMS, evaluated at the same 64^3 held-out points.
independent_evaluation.energy_and_spectrum: Periodic-grid diagnostics from the same predicted and exact velocity arrays; full FFT shell spectrum, even grid width.
independent_evaluation.divergence: Maximum absolute predicted divergence, normalized by the maximum sampled Frobenius norm of the exact velocity gradient.
independent_evaluation.continuous_extrema: Not certified by this finite validation grid; continuous peak verdict remains UNCERTAIN.

threshold_rationale: Use the same benchmark policy limits as the frozen OpenFOAM Foundation 13 protocol for cross-target comparability. These are engineering acceptance tolerances, not mathematical error bounds or physical safety limits.

decision_rules.per_model_sampled_quality: PASS iff every listed sampled metric is at or below its inclusive threshold; otherwise FAIL.
decision_rules.continuous_local_quality: UNCERTAIN unless a valid continuous-domain enclosure is independently supplied.
decision_rules.historical_results: The existing v1 verdicts remain unchanged. This prospective re-evaluation uses a new shifted grid; it does not retroactively preregister or overwrite v1 decisions.
decision_rules.hypothesis: A sampled blind spot is reproduced only when run-integrity passes while at least one global metric passes and a preregistered local metric fails; report metric-specific statuses and do not infer solver defects or physical phenomena.

scope_limits: The endpoint t=0.05 is itself a training collocation time; only spatial evaluation points are newly held out.
The 64^3 grid yields sampled extrema, not continuous maxima.
Five initialization/sampling seeds are a small fixed design, not a population guarantee.
Fixed 5000-step training does not establish optimizer convergence.
AMR is not applicable to this fixed-architecture PINN study.
